correctness.rationale: Over F2, factor A=ECs where s records part parities, E duplicates part values and C=I+11ᵀ; sE=D=diag(ni mod2). C has rank r−[r odd]. Block multiplication gives rank A²=k−[k odd,e=0] and stabilized rank A³=k−[k odd]. For even k, A⁴=A², while for odd k, A⁴=A³; hence A eventual-image periods divide 2 and I+A periods divide 4, with characteristic-two (I+A)^2=I+A² and ^4=I+A⁴. Rank-nullity gives P_1,j=(2^(N−a1),2^(N−a2),2^(N−a3)); the fixed space on the stable A-image gives P_0=(2^u,2^a3,2^a3) where u=0 if k=0 else k−1. Möbius inversion yields exact cycle counts. Independent exhaustive all-state enumeration on 36 multipartite graphs of 2 or 3 parts with sizes 1..3 reproduces every predicted first, second, fourth fixed count and ranks; the analytic block identities prove all graph sizes.

value.rationale: Exact global orbit structure is a natural invariant in Boolean network and finite dynamical systems. Here a large exponential state space collapses to the parity of multipartite part sizes, producing sharp uniform period four, exact zeta functions and a complete incidence criterion for four-cycles. This is a complete natural graph-family classification, not an arbitrary tiny finite census or straightforward restatement of a real-spectrum theorem.
residual_risks: The result does not classify arbitrary graphs or nonlinear/affine update rules; earlier unindexed F2 network rank fact may still exist.

final_claim: For the synchronous self-exclusive A and self-inclusive I+A binary parity automata on any complete multipartite graph K_(n1,...,nr), exact counts of configurations fixed by iterates 1,2,4 and all primitive 1-,2-,4-cycle counts are explicit powers of two determined by N,r,number k of odd parts and e=r−k. No other primitive periods occur; inclusive four-cycles exist exactly for k odd with e>0.
limitations: Only complete multipartite, all parts nonempty, no self-loops, synchronous XOR maps, no affine input.
